assets: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square RPG inventory card artwork for Walking Hard, named Recoil Harness. Create a single centered futuristic armored chest harness, no wearer: dark gunmetal and pale teal plates, two clearly visible mechanical recoil dampers along the shoulder straps and a compact cyan energy capacitor at the sternum. A faint small shield arc suggests stored impact energy. Polished painted 3D game-item illustration, crisp silhouette readable at 64 pixels, restrained cool rim lighting and bright metal edges, nearly black navy background. The whole harness fits with generous margin. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI frame, no rarity border, no watermark. Square 1024x1024.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square RPG ability card artwork for Walking Hard, named Suppressive Volley. A compact futuristic wrist-mounted emitter at the lower left projects exactly three bright white-cyan energy bolts in a narrow fan toward three small distant mechanical target silhouettes; each impact has a sharp interruption spark. Emphasize the three shot paths and a controlled precise fan rather than a huge explosion. Polished painted 3D game-ability illustration, dark gunmetal emitter with pale teal panels, bright crisp edges, readable at 64 pixels, nearly black navy background with restrained cyan glow. Everything fits inside a square with margin. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI frame, no rarity border, no watermark. Square 1024x1024.
